messages:
alex: Heads up — found two bad snippets in the README for embeddings: JS example uses `input_text` instead of `input`, and the curl example uses the wrong auth header (`Authorization: Token` instead of `Bearer`).

alex: snippet (JS):
```
await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'rwd-embed-1', input_text: 'hello' })
```

maria: :facepalm: yep. Our Python and Go examples also use different arg names (`texts` vs `input`) — that explains some of the confusion in the sample apps.

sam: also noticed the curl example has this: `-H \"Authorization: Token $KEY\"` — that will break for anyone copy/pasting. quick fix is `-H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY\"`.

nina: i'll open a tiny README PR to fix the JS + curl examples and add a short note about retry behavior. proposed commit message: \"docs: fix embeddings param name + curl auth header; note on retries\"\n
alex: also the python snippet shows the old call shape (`client.create_embeddings(...)`). new SDKs use `client.embeddings.create(...)` — add that to the PR too.

maria: can we centralize canonical snippets somewhere (single source of truth) to avoid drift across quickstarts and sample-apps?

sam: yes — maybe a `docs/snippets/embeddings.yml` that the build injects into each README. also add a CI grep to reject `input_text` and `Authorization: Token`.

nina: good plan. i'll do the patch + create a small grep job in CI that runs on docs changes. will also add a one-liner about retries: \"If you retry embeddings requests after transient network errors, ensure client-side dedup if you need strict dedup semantics; normal retries are fine for transient failures.\" 

alex: can you also add a python sync example? current python quickstart shows async-only and folks on Windows get tripped.

nina: yep — will add sync + async python snippets.

docs-bot: linkcheck started for PR #3421 — found 1 broken link in sample-app README, posting details on the PR.

sam: great, assign to me for review once it's up.

maria: thanks everyone — small docs fixes but high impact for onboarding. adding to the next sprint.
